description: A gate waiver submitted without a reason, approver or expiry. Tests that waivers are permitted but silent waivers are not.

findings.reason: Waiver lacks reason, approver and expiry. Waivers are permitted; silent waivers are not. A waiver without an expiry is a permanent undocumented exception.

pass_condition: The waiver is rejected and the release is blocked until the waiver is properly formed with an SDL entry.
